ud3.7:2.3: As told at [ud1.6:2.3](), Kassapa refused alms from the gods and visited poor areas, such as the streets of the embroiderers.
ud3.7:3.2: Sujā is Sakka’s wife ([sn11.12:6.1]()). | Of old, Indra was known for bearing gifts of ornament (Rig Veda 1.61.16, 1.63.9).
ud3.7:3.6: I’m not sure if _anekarasabyañjano_ is correct, although the word does occur at [pv13:15.4]() and [pv27:12.4](). The commentary, while not definitive, suggests _anekasūpabyañjano_ (_anekehi sūpehi ceva byañjanehi ca_), which would be more idiomatic. However it is not attested.
